basic_details.job_title: IIM Lucknow Senior Research Assistant (Communication) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Management Lucknow has invited applications for one contractual Senior Research Assistant position in the Communication Area under Dr Medha Bakhshi, with a consolidated monthly fellowship of Rs. 50,000 plus HRA as per applicable norms. The initial appointment is for six months. Candidates need a postgraduate degree with a minimum of two years of relevant post-qualification experience, and must apply through the Google form by 15 November 2026 (Sunday).

how_to_apply: Applications are made by filling out the Google form linked in the notice, mentioning the key details (resume, marks, work experience etc.). The last date to apply is 15 November 2026 (Sunday). Applications received after the last date, or with incomplete information, will be rejected. Queries may be sent to [email protected].
important_instructions: Incomplete or ineligible applications will be deemed invalid and rejected without intimation to the candidate. Only eligible candidates will be called for the interview. Only selected candidates will be informed. No other query will be entertained. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview, if called for. Canvassing through any means will be taken seriously, and the candidate is liable to be rejected.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Management Lucknow is located at Prabandh Nagar, IIM Road, Lucknow - 226013 (U.P.). This position is a contractual research post attached to a faculty member in the institute's Communication Area. The notice is dated 6 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice states that candidates must hold the minimum qualification for the position, preferably in Communication, Gender Studies, Management, Sociology, Cultural Studies or a relevant field. The notice asks for strong research competence and subject expertise. The notice also asks for an excellent academic record with First Class performance throughout, including Postgraduation in Management, Communications, Gender Studies, Social Sciences or related subjects. The degree must be from a reputed institute or university and completed in regular mode. Desirable requirements printed in the notice: Demonstrated familiarity with qualitative research methodologies, particularly qualitative data collection, analysis and interpretation. Experience with interviews, focus group discussions, ethnographic methods, critical discourse analysis and textual analysis would be an advantage. Preference shall be given to candidates who have supported a research publication process (for example through data collection or analysis) or have published research papers in reputed journals. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Postgraduate degree with a minimum of two years of relevant post-qualification experience
rows.desirable: Familiarity with qualitative research methods; research publication experience

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly fellowship of Rs. 50,000 plus HRA as per applicable norms. The position is purely contractual. The appointment is for an initial period of six months, which may be extended based on performance and institute requirements.

content_sections.heading: IIM Lucknow Senior Research Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the work as assisting the faculty member in research and related works, including but not limited to: Conducting in-depth interviews Literature reviews Conceptualizing, designing and conducting research projects Primary and secondary data collection and analysis Writing academic reports and research papers

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Lucknow Senior Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Applications are made by filling out the Google form linked in the notice, mentioning the key details (resume, marks, work experience etc.). The last date to apply is 15 November 2026 (Sunday). Applications received after the last date, or with incomplete information, will be rejected. Queries may be sent to [email protected] . Documents named in the notice: Resume Marks details Work experience details

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: All applications received will be scrutinised. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted by email for an interview, which will be conducted in online mode only. The final selection will be based on the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience and performance during the online interaction. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete or ineligible applications will be deemed invalid and rejected without intimation to the candidate. Only eligible candidates will be called for the interview. Only selected candidates will be informed. No other query will be entertained. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview, if called for. Canvassing through any means will be taken seriously, and the candidate is liable to be rejected.
